interaction.prompt: White has the puck on the half-wall and is about to pass. Which white player do you move to cover RIGHT NOW before the puck gets there?

feedback.right: Good read! The white player at the front of the net can tip or redirect any pass. Cover them before the puck arrives — not after.
feedback.wrong: Find the white player closest to your goalie. They are standing right at the net — ready to tip a pass into a goal. That is the most dangerous spot in the zone.

tip: Every time the puck is on the half-wall, scan the front of YOUR net first. A white jersey near the crease can turn any pass into a goal before you can react.
why: Anticipating the net-front pass is the anchor read in defensive zone coverage. U11 players tend to watch the puck carrier on the half-wall instead of scanning the crease — this scenario trains the habit of finding the net-front threat before the pass is made.
